description: Scan restaurant menus and compare dishes against food preferences, ingredient choices, and eating styles.

defaultPrompt: Scan this menu and tell me what I can eat.

interface.longDescription: Upload or paste a restaurant menu and quickly see which dishes match your food preferences. Dietary Menu Scanner by Omealo highlights likely matches, items that are genuinely unclear from the menu, and dishes that do not match based on the listed ingredients.
